name: Obeying Authority
overview: Scripture teaches that all authority is established by God, and believers are called to submit to governing powers as they serve God's ordained purpose (Romans 13:1-2; Titus 3:1). However, this submission is not absolute; when human authority conflicts with God's commands, obedience to God must take precedence, as Peter and the apostles declared (Acts 5:29). Additionally, believers are instructed to obey their spiritual leaders with willing hearts, recognizing that such leaders are accountable to God for their care (Hebrews 13:17). This balance reflects a Christ-centered understanding of authority that honors God above all.
